title: Käthe Kollwitz
description: Käthe Kollwitz was an important artist of the 20th century whose drawings, prints and sculptures reflected the pain and grief of people suffering from social injustice and war.

title: Claude Monet
description: Claude Monet was an important French painter of the 19th century. His paintings often depict natural motifs and are characterized by vivid colors. He was also very interested in the changes in light.

title: Das Mittelalter
description: The European Middle Ages began around the year 500 AD, when the age of antiquity ended. title: Der Golfstrom
description: On its way from the Caribbean to northern Europe, the Gulf Stream brings our continent a mild climate that is unique in the world. Without the Gulf Stream, we could be facing a winter as harsh and cold as Siberia every year.

title: Der Kalte Krieg
description: After the end of the Second World War in 1945, a new form of war begins, a "cold war" between the two superpowers, the USA and the Soviet Union. title: Der fruchtbare Lössboden
description: Loess soils are diverse. Due to their fertility, they play a major role in agriculture. Their formation dates back to the ice ages when large parts of Europe were covered by mighty glaciers.

title: Die Berliner Mauer
description: For 28 years, the western part of the city of Berlin was surrounded by a wall - in the middle of the territory of the German Democratic Republic (GDR) and separated from the rest of the western part of the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG). title: Die Erfindungen von Leonardo da Vinci
description: Bicycle chains, car gearboxes, parachutes - none of this would probably exist today without Leonardo da Vinci. Many of his drawings and sketches are still preserved and he wrote his notebooks in mirror writing. Da Vinci is still considered a genius today.

title: Die Französische Revolution und Napoleon
description: On July 14, 1789, peasants and citizens in Paris storm the Bastille, the king's state prison and armory. This marks the beginning of the French Revolution. title: Die Hanse
description: For centuries in the Middle Ages, the German merchants of the Hanseatic League dominated the transportation of goods along the entire North Sea and Baltic coasts. title: Die Industrielle Revolution
description: For thousands of years, people did almost all the work themselves. Then came industrialization: fast machines replaced manual labour. This process first took place in Great Britain in the 1760s. Working conditions and the economy change radically.

title: Die Maya
description: Around 2000 BC, the Maya developed an advanced civilization that lasted for many centuries in what is now Guatemala and Mexico. title: Die Steinzeit
description: The Stone Age lasted around 2.5 million years. During this long period, people continued to develop their tools and weapons. Some of these achievements are still in use today.

title: Die UNO
description: On October 24, 1945, 51 states adopt a charter, a common international treaty, in San Francisco. This marks the birth of the United Nations. The English term is more commonly used: United Nations Organization, UNO for short - or just United Nations, UN for short.

title: Die Wikinger
description: Many legends and myths surround the Vikings from the far north. One thing is certain: They terrified the people on Europe's coasts with their lightning raids. title: Erdöl
description: A world without plastic, cars or asphalt is almost unimaginable today. All of this is made from crude oil. But what is crude oil anyway and how is it produced?

title: Parteien und Kanzlerin und Kanzler – wer wählt wen in Deutschland?
description: In Germany, we have what is known as a representative democracy. Citizens can only elect parties to the Bundestag through their vote. The Federal Chancellor is elected differently. Planet Wissen shows how this works.

title: Vincent van Gogh
description: Van Gogh was a Dutch painter of the 19th century and is considered one of the founders of modern painting. Works such as the "Sunflowers" are world-famous. He had psychological problems and probably cut off part of his left ear while delusional.
